# Limani Labs

> Limani Labs builds websites and protects the email of businesses in Cyprus, based in Nicosia. Contact: info@limanilabs.com. Greek and English.

Facts in short (prices exclude VAT):

- Email protection: Introductory price €49 for the first 5 clients, then €79 per domain
- Website check: Free
- Basic accessibility report: from €149
- Yearly care: €99 a year
- Websites: €390 for one page · €690 for up to 5 pages · Hosting and maintenance from €20 / month
- Free email check on the website: free, no sign-up

## Key pages

- [Facts and short answers (English)](https://limanilabs.com/facts/): who we are, area, services, prices, contact, five short answers
- [Τα βασικά και σύντομες απαντήσεις (Ελληνικά)](https://limanilabs.com/el/facts/): the same facts in Greek
- [Free email check](https://limanilabs.com/email/): does your domain ask email services to block fake email in your name
- [Services and prices](https://limanilabs.com/services/): email protection, website check, accessibility report, yearly care, websites
- [Websites](https://limanilabs.com/websites/): prices, what is included, demo sites
- [About](https://limanilabs.com/about/): the company and the founder

## Optional
